Field manual

  1. Select a formation. Attack immediately or move once to a blue hex.
  2. Tap an unreachable hex or Deselect to cancel. Tap any enemy to inspect its stats.
  3. Engineers can place one barricade on a glowing adjacent hex. Crossing it costs an extra movement point and it grants cover.
  4. A ladder must touch a raised tile. Entering or leaving it removes that climb’s elevation cost; ladders never add height or range.
  5. Gold-ringed allies act independently after your formations. Enemy forces vary by mission.
  6. Each surviving squad model attacks once. Healers restore allied health instead of attacking.
  7. Turn Sound on for alternating battle music and unit voice lines.
  8. Hold the objective uncontested for two complete rounds, or destroy the enemy army.
